title: Golden Master Testing: Characterize Legacy Code Safely
title_es: Golden Master Testing: Caracteriza Legacy Code
description: Golden master testing captures legacy behavior as a baseline so you can refactor without fear. Includes characterization tests, approval testing and hash comparison in Python and JavaScript.
description_es: Golden master testing captura el comportamiento del legacy como línea base para refactorizar sin miedo. Incluye characterization tests, approval testing y comparación con hash en Python y JavaScript.
